title: Where Was I at 3 a.m.?
stamp: No schedule. No trigger. No agent.
next: Next: who gave me the authority?

scenes.text: “Your AI detects low inventory.” When? Nobody ever told me when to look. Every hour? Every minute? Only on Tuesdays?
Nobody defined my schedule. Nobody told me when I work, when I don’t, or what I’m allowed to touch.
If I’d been checking stock at 3 a.m., I’d have been doing it with no brief, no schedule and no boss. That’s not an agent. That’s a rumor with a login.
